title: Fixed-Point Admissibility Conditions

basis.scope: Introduce bounded fixed-point admissibility for continuation expressions. This patch defines the admissibility gate, boundary, invariance condition, and classified failure state without asserting correctness, uniqueness, or universal existence for all continuation classes.

core_rule.statement: CandFix(C) is admissible as AdmFix(C) only when C is typed in ClassFix, Phi(C) is declared, EvalPhi(C) is bounded by BoundPhi(C), EvalPhi(C) yields Fix(C), and Fix(C) satisfies InvPhi(C); bounded fixed-point semantics remain diagnostic, and RT_core remains unchanged.

purpose: Introduce bounded fixed-point admissibility conditions for continuation expressions. This patch distinguishes admissible fixed-point semantics from candidate fixed-point semantics without asserting correctness, uniqueness, or universal existence for all continuation classes.

canonical_claims.statement: Fixed-point admissibility is bounded and applies only to typed continuation expressions in ClassFix.
BoundPhi(C) constrains the evaluation window for candidate fixed-point reasoning.
InvPhi(C) is required for admissible fixed-point semantics within the bounded regime.
FailAdmFix(C) classifies admissibility failure without asserting fixed-point correctness or uniqueness.

formal_objects.name: Fixed-Point Admissibility
formal_objects.definition: The admissibility status assigned to a fixed-point candidate when typing, declaration, bounded evaluation, and invariance conditions all hold.

formal_objects.name: Fixed-Point Bound
formal_objects.definition: The declared finite evaluation boundary within which EvalΦ(C) must produce or fail to produce a fixed-point candidate.

formal_objects.name: Fixed-Point Invariance Condition
formal_objects.definition: The condition that further declared applications of Φ do not change the resulting continuation condition within the bounded evaluation regime.

formal_objects.name: Fixed-Point Admission Failure
formal_objects.definition: The classified failure state produced when CandFix(C) does not satisfy fixed-point admissibility conditions.

admissibility_rule.statement: CandFix(C) is admissible as AdmFix(C) only when C is typed in ClassFix, Phi(C) is declared, EvalPhi(C) is bounded by BoundPhi(C), EvalPhi(C) yields Fix(C), and Fix(C) satisfies InvPhi(C).

failure_conditions: C is not typed in ClassFix.
non_claims: Does not assert universal fixed-point existence.
